about: Every audit row the 2026-10-04 re-read removed (old uid no longer in the audit) and every row it added, by cause. One cause per removed row, tested in the order 4, 2, c, 1, 3. Added rows: a = on a line the second listen changed, b = on a line it did not change.

causes.1: existed only in the retired second reader pass (13 older lessons; that pass read the text of 2026-09-26)
causes.2: his line's text changed at that spot: the second listen removed or changed the quoted wrong piece (a likely false slip from a mishearing)
causes.3: the line did not change there: the readers simply did not write it this time (reader variance)
causes.4: not gone: the same slip is still in the audit on another row (merged - late pairing with the 09-24 sweep row, or one slip written once)
causes.c: a human ruling had rejected it (Amal on her Tutor page) and the readers did not write it again

added_kinds.a: on a line the second listen changed
added_kinds.b: on a line the second listen did not change
